question: Should maintainers authorize the new shipped dependency and registration identity after exact-head WhatsApp-device proof confirms the claimed behavior?
rationale: Baileys source supports the design, but only external-device evidence can establish WhatsApp acceptance, real intermediate credentials, and the user-visible linked-device identity; repository policy separately requires dependency authorization.
